description: Use for 'is this agent / firm licensed for citizenship or residency by investment' or 'who are the authorised agents for X' — e.g. 'is Arton Capital an authorised agent for Saint Lucia', 'licensed agents for the St Kitts CBI', 'check licence RES-ACCA'. Searches the official government lists of licensed / authorised agents for St Kitts and Nevis, Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Lucia, Malta (MPRP residency), Vanuatu and Nauru. Optional `name` (firm, person or licence number; word order, accents, punctuation and company endings ignored) and optional `country` (ISO-3166 code or English name); omit both to get the 8 lists with entry counts and official source URLs. Returns matches with list section, licence number (only Saint Lucia and Malta publish them), website, authority and the official `source_url`, plus `checked_at`. No emails or phone numbers. A country outside the 8 returns `list_available: false`. A name matches when every query word is a whole word of it, so compare the exact name and licence number before telling someone a firm is listed: a similarly named firm is not the same firm. Not finding a name does not prove a firm is unlicensed — say so and point to `source_url`.

country.description: Programme country: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'St Kitts and Nevis', 'GD', 'Malta'. Omit to search all lists.

name.description: Firm or person name, or a licence number, e.g. 'Arton Capital', 'Nuri Katz', 'RES-ACCA'. Word order, accents, punctuation and company endings (Ltd, Inc) are ignored.

name: check_licensed_agent
title: Check a licensed citizenship / residency agent
